summary: Ust-Maya Airport (UMS/UEMU) is a small regional airport serving the remote settlement of Ust-Maya in the Sakha Republic (Yakutia), located in eastern Siberia, Russia. It provides essential air connectivity to one of the most isolated inhabited areas in the region, where ground transportation infrastructure is extremely limited. The airport primarily handles short-haul regional flights supporting the local community and resource-based industries.
